description: This file defines the FormatterPluginManager class, which manages field formatter plugins in Drupal. It includes methods for creating plugin instances, retrieving formatter options, and default settings, and interacts with other Drupal core components.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Field\FormatterPluginManager
classes.description: Manages field formatter plugins, providing creation, configuration, and options management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FormatterPluginManager with necessary dependencies and configuration.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of a formatter plugin based on plugin ID and configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves a formatter plugin instance based on provided options, with fallback to default formatter.

methods.name: prepareConfiguration
methods.description: Merges default values into formatter configuration, ensuring all required keys are set.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns available formatter options for a given field type or all field types.

methods.name: getDefaultSettings
methods.description: Retrieves default settings for a specific formatter type.
